name: Gakuen Toshi Z
source:
In the floating in space academic city of Z students compete against each other using their own robots. This year just one day before competition the Red team members got intoxicated by food poisoning. Just one red team was intact. So the rules were changed - if Red team gathers five crystals scattered throughout the school - it wins. Otherwise white team wins. And now single Red robot faces 20,000 white robots.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-may-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在漂浮在太空的学术城Z中，学生们使用自己的机器人相互竞争。今年，就在比赛前一天，红队队员食物中毒。只有一支红队完好无损。因此规则发生了变化——如果红队收集了散布在学校各处的五颗水晶——它就获胜了。否则白队获胜。现在单个红色机器人面对20,000个白色机器人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-may-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
